about: Stop times (version 3): a station listed twice or on no line, dwells and minimum stops out of range, and a minimum stop at the last stop.
problems: station "B": the dwell must be 0 to 600 seconds
station "B": the minimum stop must be 0 to 600 seconds
station "X": is not a station of any line
stations[4]: the name must not be empty, start or end with a space, or contain a control character
stations[4]: the minimum stop must be 0 to 600 seconds
train "1", stop 2 "B": the minimum stop must be 0 to 600 seconds
train "1", stop 3 "C": is the last stop, which the train does not leave, so it has no minimum stop
